propositions: The code-review-verify spec emits no decision polarity (verdict or findings), causing all cases to score as advisory regardless of gold label, creating guaranteed recall misses on both standard and frontier arms.
The spec contract requires non-empty verifications for both gold-block and gold-advisory cases, so mapping presence to block would fix one miss but manufacture a false accept on clean cases.
Code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus via a separate named exclusion mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS, preserving the reason (no decision polarity) for future readers.
Excluding the two verify cases reduces n_gold from 28 to 26, still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS threshold, removing symmetric recall misses without changing gating verdicts or false-accept outcomes.
